Name: Underdew Vally
Author: HeyImBlue3
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]This mod is a work in progress. Features may look unfinished, and/or not work properly. [/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds Ceroba and Kanako from Undertale Yellow to Stardew Vally.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ ﻿
2. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Adds Ceroba and Kanako as an NPC.[/b][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Adds the interior of the Ketsukane mansion, which you can enter by clicking at a UGPS sign bell north of the bus station[/b][/color][/size]
Adds a a new weapon, Chujin's Staff. (Currently unobtainable without cheats)
Ceroba can be found in a few vanilla events

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Requires  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color]
